<div id="A6.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent ltx_align_center"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p3.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="750.53" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 675 750.53" width="675"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,750.53) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 8.57 L 0 741.96 C 0 746.69 3.84 750.53 8.57 750.53 L 666.43 750.53 C 671.16 750.53 675 746.69 675 741.96 L 675 8.57 C 675 3.84 671.16 0 666.43 0 L 8.57 0 C 3.84 0 0 3.84 0 8.57 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F9F9F9;" fill="#F9F9F9" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0.69 8.57 L 0.69 741.96 C 0.69 746.31 4.22 749.83 8.57 749.83 L 666.43 749.83 C 670.78 749.83 674.31 746.31 674.31 741.96 L 674.31 8.57 C 674.31 4.22 670.78 0.69 666.43 0.69 L 8.57 0.69 C 4.22 0.69 0.69 4.22 0.69 8.57 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 20.38 15.58)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:43.66em;--ltx-fo-height:52.21em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="725.53" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 722.45)" width="604.13"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:43.66em;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.1.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are a time series analysis expert. Your task is to decide which time series segments an LLM needs to accurately answer a question related to a time series.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">## Instructions</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.4.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">1. You receive the FULL time series embedding, the question, the segments that were given to the LLM so far, and the LLM’s answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.5.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">2. Review the question and the LLM’s answer, and analyze the full time series embedding.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.6.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">3. Evaluate if the LLM’s answer is accurate and if the available segments provide sufficient information to answer the question accurately - you can try answering the question yourself to understand what is missing.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">4. Make ONE of two decisions:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.8.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">- Retrieve an additional segment: If you think that the answer is not accurate and/or there is critical information missing, use the tool to get an additional segment of time series data for the LLM.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.9.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">- Accept the LLM’s answer as final: If you think the LLM’s answer is accurate and the information provided is sufficient.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.37" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.38" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">## Important Rules</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">1. You can only call ’timeseries_selection_tool’ ONCE per turn</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.40" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">2. Specify segments as integers: [100, 200] means timesteps 100 to 200 inclusive</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.41" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">4. Do NOT request segments outside valid range [0, {ts_len - 1}]</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:21.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.42.1.4" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:437.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">5. If you output "ACCEPT", the process will immediately conclude with the LLM’s current answer</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.43" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.44" class="ltx_p" style="width:458.4pt;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:458.4pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.p3.pic1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:458.4pt;">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p3.pic1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">Make your decision now:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
</div>
